text:
Emma: Heads-up 10/22 launch target for the 'Throughput & Cost' update. Marketing needs final changelog URL, docs link for API example, and a webinar RSVP link to schedule emails + social. Can eng confirm canary timing and final benchmark figure?

Jorge: We can aim for the 10/22 ship. Proposed canary: 09:00011:00 PT on canary-pool-1. Benchmarks are nearly final; I'll paste the cleaned numbers in a sec. Changelog draft is here: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/throughput-changelog.

Priya: Timebox: marketing needs final links + 3 bullets for hero copy by EOD today so legal and comms can approve. Also need a short webinar outline (25m), registration CTA, and the fields we capture on the form.

Mark: Docs PR open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/805 1api examples need updated for batch_size param. I'll make the small change now.

Sarah: I'll build the slide skeleton: 1
 slide on cost/token, 1 slide on latency improvements, 1 customer use case. Keep benchmark language conservative. I'll upload a draft deck link when Mark merges.

Jorge: Finalized bench (8k context):
- Avg token cost: 33% lower vs baseline
- p50 latency: 16% improvement at 1k concurrent requests
- Sustained throughput: 2.4x on pool-1
I'll attach CSV to the docs PR after merge.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule locked: 2024-11-12T16:00:00Z -> 2024-11-12T18:00:00Z on pool-1. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty.

ops: We can expose a simple POST webhook for leads. Need the JSON schema for the landing form: recommend fields [email, company, role, use_case, utm_source, utm_campaign]. Also confirm whether we should include a token to verify requests.

Priya: We'll capture those fields. Schema: email (required), company (optional), role (optional), use_case (optional), utm_source (required), utm_campaign (optional). Send us the endpoint once it's up; marketing will include it in the landing page.

Mark: Webhook endpoint will be ready tonight. I'll paste the URL and example payload here when deployed.

Jorge: Changelog canonical URL added: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/throughput-v1.2 1 updated TL;DR bullets and rollback notes.

Priya: Draft social and email copy coming in ~30m. Webinar RSVP page placeholder: https://events.redwood.ai/rsvp/throughput-launch (we'll swap in real RSVP when HubSpot form is live).

Sarah: Deck uploaded (work-in-progress): https://drive.redwood.ai/throughput-launch-deck-v0.4 1 please comment, will lock after docs merge.

Emma: Thanks all. Final checklist for marketing to publish on 10/22 17:00 UTC: 1) changelog URL, 2) docs API example canonical link, 3) live webinar RSVP or placeholder, 4) webhook endpoint for leads. If any of these miss the EOD cut we'll postpone the external announcement.

Mark: I'll confirm webhook URL + example POST.

Jorge: I'll merge docs PR after Mark's API example update.

Priya: Social + webinar invite copy will be posted here once HubSpot form is wired. :rocket:

Emma: Locking on 10/22 unless blockers by EOD. Thanks!
